description: Who grew and who shrank most in a niche, over a window we have already archived — the comparison done for you, ranked. Call `archive_coverage` first: it lists the valid niche ids and how far back each one goes. `hours` is 1 to 720 (30 days) and defaults to 24; `limit` is 1 to 100 and defaults to 20. A value outside the range is rejected rather than silently trimmed. Requires an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` — free key at https://honesthook.com/docs#key; costs 10 credits — free when nothing moved.

hours.description: How many hours back the window goes. Optional, 1 to 720, 24 by default. Outside that range the API answers 400.

limit.description: How many movers to return. Optional, 1 to 100, 20 by default. Outside that range the API answers 400.

niche.description: The niche id, as `archive_coverage` returns it — for example `ai-agents`. A niche we do not archive is refused by the API.

name: archive_movers
title: Biggest movers in a niche
